expected_items.description: Interpret the user's positive vision expert request as a reusable platform agent for grounded optimism and make-it-happen execution framing.
expected_items.rationale: The request was summarized and the plan records the Positive Vision agent interpretation.

expected_items.description: Run web-first research and save a public search record.
expected_items.rationale: The search record lists queries, sources checked, weak sources ignored, plan impact, and uncertainty.

expected_items.description: Add or link the durable requirement for the Positive Vision agent.
Create an inspectable agent spec with positive vision, agency, pathways, if-then plans, risk truth, fallback, and verification gates.
expected_items.rationale: The agent spec includes trigger, output contract, vision modes, safety rules, and validation commands.

expected_items.description: Ensure positive vision does not become unsupported success guarantees, risk hiding, dissent suppression, or verification bypass.
expected_items.rationale: The policy and docs explicitly prohibit unsupported guarantees and require risk truth plus verification gates.

expected_items.description: Reuse existing planning, timing, omission, grounding, and evaluation tools instead of creating a duplicate runtime.
expected_items.rationale: The agent links existing planning/evaluation tools and the timing record validates with work-timer.

acceptance_checks.description: Confirm the new agent appears in the registry list.
Run platform tests and monitor build checks.
acceptance_checks.rationale: All commands completed with exit code 0.

known_omission_risks: No standalone UI, voice interface, or runtime behavior was implemented because the current request was satisfied by a reusable platform agent spec and docs.
notes: The agent complements timekeeper-agent rather than replacing it.
